name: study2-checkpoint-2.1-cuda-validation

rest.note: v2 field names. The previous body used v1/GraphQL names (gpuType, gpuCount, cloudType, containerDiskInGb, volumeInGb) and had no image, which v2 requires.

networkVolume.note: No network volume or paid storage. The pod downloads the pinned Qwen files to its container disk and checks every sha256 against docker/cuda/qwen_files.sha256 before measuring.

image.registry: ghcr.io (public package, so no registry credential)

weights.source: Hugging Face Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct, revision 89644892e4d85e24eaac8bacfd4f463576704203, license apache-2.0, not gated

resultExport: Pod log stream (stream-pod-logs or the console). Sections are delimited by '=== BEGIN <file>' and '=== END <file>'. The last job line is exactly one of '=== JOB_DONE status=ok' or '=== JOB_FAILED step=<s> rc=<n> reason=<r>'. Only JOB_DONE status=ok is a usable result.

shutdown.inPod: Every step runs under timeout against JOB_DEADLINE_MINUTES (45). A watchdog calls self_stop.py 5 minutes after that. After the terminal line the job calls self_stop.py: REST v2 terminate, then stop, with the pod-scoped RUNPOD_API_KEY. If both are refused it prints SELF_STOP_FAILED and sleeps instead of exiting, so the container never reruns the job.
shutdown.operator: Start docker/runpod/deadline_guard.sh <pod-id> 60 on the operator machine right after create. It terminates that pod id at 60 minutes.
shutdown.notAvailable: REST v2 has no stop timer. runpodctl --stop-after/--terminate-after were never enforced by the backend and were removed in runpodctl v2.12.0; they are not a cost cap.
shutdown.unverified: Whether the pod-scoped key may terminate (not only stop) has not been checked on a live pod. Either action ends GPU billing.

estimatedCostUsd.expectedMinutes: 15-30 including image pull and the 4.3 GB weight download
